study_note: Single-seed exploratory Humanoid Walk state checkpoint bank for frozen prior versus inner-XQC evaluation. Seed 55 trains for 1.5 million agent decisions with stochastic persistent-prior collection after the unchanged random warmup, normal TOLD/XQC outer learning, and zero inner work. Online evaluation is disabled. All 60 portable checkpoint/metadata pairs are retained every 25,000 decisions. Dormant J2/N32/H3/G4, batch 64, and frozen-real-scale inner defaults are retained for explicit later evaluation. This isolates deployment-time improvement conditional on no-inner-trained priors and is not confirmatory evidence. Exact trainer resume is not supported.
